neet_phy_u11_t07_2.working: Between the sheets the fields add: E = σ/ε0 = 8.85×10^-7 / 8.85×10^-12 = 1.0×10^5 N/C. Outside they cancel, so E = 0.

neet_phy_u11_t07_3.working: Inside, E = kQr/R^3, so at R/2 it is kQ/(2R^2). Outside, at 2R it is kQ/(4R^2). The ratio is 2:1.

neet_phy_u11_t07_4.working: Line charge gives E ∝ 1/r (II). Plane sheet gives E independent of r (I). Inside a shell E = 0 (IV). Inside a solid sphere E ∝ r (III).

neet_phy_u11_t07_5.working: A is true. B is false because the field is zero at the centre. C is true (σ/ε0). D is true (ρr/3ε0). E is false because the sheet's field does not depend on distance.
